metadata.agent_last_message:
Implementation complete. Summary:

**Project structure** (in `/workspace/output/`):
- `Cargo.toml` — empty `[dependencies]`
- `src/main.rs` — CLI dispatch
- `src/cli.rs` — subcommand handlers (parse, write, query, eval, roundtrip)
- `src/json.rs` — minimal stdlib-only JSON parser/serializer
- `src/types.rs` — IGES data model (87 entity variants)
- `src/reader.rs` — section splitting for fixed-format IGES
- `src/parser.rs` — Global section, Directory Entry, free-format PD tokenizer
- `src/entities.rs` — per-entity Parameter Data parsers
- `src/writer.rs` — IGES-JSON ↔ IgesFile conversion + 80-column emitter
- `src/eval.rs` — parametric curve & surface evaluators (NURBS, B-splines, analytic surfaces, etc.)

**Verified behaviors:**
- All five subcommands (parse, write, query, eval, roundtrip) work and return correct exit codes
- Fixed-point property: `roundtrip(roundtrip(x)) == roundtrip(x)` byte-identical
- Custom delimiters (`|` / `#`), Fortran D-notation, Hollerith strings spanning lines all parse cleanly
- Eval verified for Type 100 (CircularArc), 110 (Line), 126 (NURBS Curve), 190 (PlaneSurface) — including correct application of `xform_matrix` after definition-space evaluation
- All required Global-field validations (`integer_bits`, `model_space_scale`, `min_resolution`, etc.) reject ≤0 with diagnostic substrings matching spec
- Negative entity types, even DE numbers, missing DEs all yield exit 1 with proper error envelopes
- Type 0 (Null entity) round-trips with zero PD lines; empty entities array supported
